decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the Hero V's length-only adjustment, locked geometry, and removal of the obsolete right_arm_reach_study key.
A same-message MODIFY already captures application of the identical length-only adjustment to the É accent and the geometry locked during the study.
A same-message MODIFY already replaces the broad refinement variants with the controlled Option B length study, softened-corner variant, and Option C comparison.
The source changes the second V's right-arm geometry study but does not alter its established visual hierarchy relative to the Hero V, É accent, E, or L.
The source explicitly treats the finish as locked and makes no change to the champagne-gold finish or its distribution.
The source confines the study to the Hero V, second V, and É accent and states that the overall architecture and proportions remain locked; the E and L requirements remain unchanged.
Applying the same adjustment consistently to the Hero V and É accent preserves their established shared-peak alignment; no new alignment rule is introduced.
The source explicitly states that spacing is locked and does not modify the selected Balanced Flow kerning.
The length-only V-arm study does not change the E/L cap-height rule based on the second V's left arm.
Extending the right arms along their existing lines does not change the bottom-point baseline alignment of the two Vs with the E and L.
The source provides refinement instructions but does not change the obligation to include design rationale with review rounds.
